milestone: SeLinOS root-held fixed-child construction adapter M1

platform.configuration: SeLinRootConstructM1Adapter=ON; default production M0 profile remains separate

contract.construction: Only root retains the persistent VKA and loader VSpace, accepts one exact fixed request and invokes sel4utils_configure_process for one compile-time inert child image.
contract.state: The root-local state advances FREE to ROOT_CONSTRUCTING to ROOT_CONSTRUCTED. A later duplicate receives REJECTED without allocation; no free/reset, rollback, cleanup or reuse is claimed.
contract.child: The child is spawned suspended with the fixed root-selected image and is not given a start claim.
contract.delegation: The taskd adapter client has exactly one endpoint send cap and receives status only. It receives no child TCB, CSpace, VSpace, fault endpoint, frame, mapping or allocator capability.

required_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: isolated taskd request endpoint ready.
SeLinOS root construction M1: root entering dedicated blocking construction loop.
SeLinOS root construction M1: exact fixed request accepted; root constructing.
SeLinOS root construction M1: one fixed child constructed and spawned suspended; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M1: malformed or duplicate request rejected; no allocation.
SeLinOS root construction M1 taskd client: fixed construction and duplicate refusal passed; no child cap received.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: unable to start taskd adapter client.
SeLinOS root construction M1: fixed child construction failed; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M1 taskd client: construction reply rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M1 taskd client: duplicate refusal rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M1 inert child: unexpected execution.

not_claimed: general task construction, multiple slots, arbitrary request parameters or client-selected image, stack, register, TLS, clone, scheduler, credential, VFS or device state
child capability delivery, child start, TCB control, teardown, rollback, delete, revoke, unmap, release or reuse
non-root VKA, loader VSpace, root CNode, CSpace, VSpace, fault endpoint, frame or mapping authority
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dynamic linker semantics, glibc runtime, dpkg or apt
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
